name: olania
description: Olania (Olaf + Lana) - Asistente personal flotante e insistente para Project Managers

scripts.build:mac: npm run build && rm -rf Olania.app && cp -R node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app Olania.app && mkdir -p Olania.app/Contents/Resources/app && cp package.json Olania.app/Contents/Resources/app/ && cp -R electron dist Olania.app/Contents/Resources/app/ && cp /tmp/olania.iconset/../* 2>/dev/null || true && codesign --force --deep --sign - Olania.app
